meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares. Polarity inherited from the receiving package.

assignments.node_id: שהשם יתברך מסתכל בארץ ישראל תמיד
assignments.node_text: שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מִסְתַּכֵּל בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמִיד
assignments.reason: This node describes God's constant gaze upon Eretz Yisrael: 'תָּמִיד עֵינֵי ה' אֱלֹקֶיךָ בָּהּ.' Its essential nature is the divine eyes/hashgachah — the einayim of Hashem that define Package 1. The Torah explicitly states: 'מֵחֲמַת שֶׁעֵינֵי ה' בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁמִּסְתַּכֵּל בָּהּ תָּמִיד' — the eyes of God looking is what creates the wisdom-quality. This is the divine dimension of the einayim concept in Package 1.

assignments.partner_node: שהשם יתברך מסתכל בארץ ישראל תמיד
assignments.reason: This is a verbose formulation combining the concepts already in Package 1 via additions: קדשת ארץ ישראל and אוירא דארץ ישראל מחכים. Its essential nature is the wisdom-sanctification quality of Eretz Yisrael — the defining expression of Chokhmah (Package 1's dominant node) as it manifests geographically.

The Torah states: 'עִקָּר מַעֲלַת קְדֻשַּׁת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי הַשְׁגָּחַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.' Hashgachah (divine oversight) is the active function of the einayim — 'בְּחִינַת עֵינַיִם לְהַשְׁגִּיחַ.' Its essential nature is God's looking/seeing, which IS the bechina of einayim. Einayim is a core node in Package 1. Note: this node appears in two edges (both with partner 'קדשת ארץ ישראל') with identical assignment.
This is a direct reference to the עינים node in Package 1 — 'the bechina of eyes.' It is literally the same concept as the Package 1 node עינים, phrased with the 'bechina' prefix.

assignments.node_id: נשמות ישראל, שהשם יתברך מתפאר בהם
assignments.node_text: נִשְׁמוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מִתְפָּאֵר בָּהֶם
assignments.partner_node: ונתעורר זאת אצל השם יתברך, דהינו בחינת עינים להשגיח
assignments.reason: This node describes the souls of Israel in whom God takes pride — 'יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּךָ אֶתְפָּאָר.' Its essential nature is the hitpaarut (divine pride in Israel), which is the defining quality of Package 2. The additions file places התפארות in Package 2, and this node describes the source of that hitpaarut: the neshemot of Israel who draw close to God through the tzaddik. The subject is Israel-as-source-of-glory, which is the king/tzaddik domain.

Already assigned to Package 2 via additions file. The Torah states 'וְעַל יְדֵי הַהִתְפָּאֲרוּת נַעֲשִׂין בְּחִינַת תְּפִלִּין' — hitpaarut produces tefillin. The hitpaarut is the essential nature of the tzaddik/king domain (Package 2).
